description: dagre's buildLayerMatrix does layering[rank][order]=v; a dummy whose cluster parent does not span its rank never gets re-ordered in sweeps (unreachable from the layer-graph root), keeps a stale order, and collides with another node's slot — the earlier node silently drops out of the matrix and of positioning. Selkie's port keeps both nodes (stable sort). Affects channel_flowchart_data_collection (_d8_29, parent subGraph2 span 9..11 at rank 8) and channel_flowchart_clippy_fix (rank 9), shifting 3 orders by 1 in each. Replicating would need care: dropped nodes get no BK x-coordinate (NaN risk in edge paths).
title: Consider replicating dagre buildLayerMatrix collision for out-of-span dummies
